games.name: [RANKED] Inazuma Strikers
games.desc:
Inazuma Strikers is a football RPG experience inspired by the legendary anime Inazuma Eleven.

🔥 Train your player, level up, improve your stats, unlock powerful Hissatsu Techniques, and compete against other players to become the greatest player  in Inazuma!

❤️ This game was created by passionate Inazuma Eleven fans as a tribute to the series. While inspired by the anime, it is an original fan-made experience built to share our love for the franchise with the community.

🎮 Controls
🖱 Left Click – Shoot
🖱 Right Click – Pass
H - Header
Q – Dribble
F – Slide Tackle
E – Rainbow Flick
Z – Standing Tackle 

⚽ Step onto the pitch, master your skills, build your dream player, and become a true football legend!

games.name: Color Hide and Seek
games.desc:
🔥 Use code "like75k" and LIKE the game for free reward!!!
👍 NEW CODE releases once the game gets 80K LIKES!!!
🎁 Special code: "hide2023"

Seekers：Catch all players who haven't successfully hidden.
Hiders：According to the system prompt, hide next to the right color blocks.

At the beginning, one player gets chosen to be 'It'. 'It' has to try and find the other players. 'It' can run faster than everyone else, so the hiders should run near the right color blocks as quickly as possible to avoid being caught. So good luck and enjoy the game.

games.name: [Russia] Musketry
games.desc:
Musketry is a team deathmatch game set during the Napoleonic Wars, inspired by Blood and Iron.

Take part in battles across a variety of realistic and fictional settings, fighting alongside your nation to overcome the opposing forces and secure victory.

Choose from a wide range of classes, each offering different weapons and roles on the battlefield. Customize your character to your liking and find a playstyle that suits you.

Fight alongside your friends, coordinate with your teammates, and use tactics to gain the upper hand against those foolish enough to stand against your nation.

If you enjoy Musketry, consider leaving a like and adding the game to your favorites. Your support helps us continue developing the game and bringing new content and improvements.

Multiplayer: Murder NPCs with up to 8 players

Welcome to the 10th Annual Post‑War "Deadly Golf" Championship.

Block, blast, or bamboozle your friends – everything is allowed as long as they miss the putt.

Space - Jump (double-tap to dive)

Mouse Wheel - Fine-tune angle

No rules. Sabotage your friends. First in the hole wins!
